# `socket-track` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "socket-track" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/socket-track/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique track id, named by moves’ hitbox.track, e.g. "knight-sword-arc-light-1". |
| `notes` | string | required | The arc in words (moves, pivot, angles), for owner review. |
| `keys` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Socket poses at tick resolution: key 0 before the first active tick, key k on active tick k. At most the move’s active ticks + 1; a shorter track holds its last key. |
| `keys[].position` | object | required | Socket position in the attacker’s frame, metres (+z forward, +y up, +x right). |
| `keys[].position.x` | number | required |  |
| `keys[].position.y` | number | required |  |
| `keys[].position.z` | number | required |  |
| `keys[].rotation` | object | required | Socket rotation in the attacker’s frame, a unit quaternion { x, y, z, w }. |
| `keys[].rotation.x` | number | required |  |
| `keys[].rotation.y` | number | required |  |
| `keys[].rotation.z` | number | required |  |
| `keys[].rotation.w` | number | required |  |
